dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent closed 'O' and open 'C' shaped structures along the mid-dorsal region exhibit irregular, jagged outer perimeters. The gradient transition is sharp, moving from high-intensity light-gray lines to the low-intensity charcoal-black of the surrounding coat.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, localized, high-intensity white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients is observed. These are concentrated primarily within the interstitial spaces between the larger ring structures and along the lower lateral-ventral boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the central dorsal field form an obtuse scalene triangle. A secondary set of four high-intensity blobs forms an irregular quadrilateral directly posterior to the primary flipper attachment point.

other_distinctive_markers: Interlocking labyrinthine network of light-colored markings creating a continuous mosaic pattern across the entire visible dorsal-lateral surface.
